description: This file defines the SupService class, which manages supplementary service handling in a modem simulator, including USSD, CLIR, call waiting, call forwarding, and service notifications. It also contains nested structures for managing CLIR status, call forwarding info, and call waiting info.

classes.name: SupService
classes.description: A class that extends ModemService to handle supplementary telephony services such as USSD, CLIR, call waiting, call forwarding, and notifications within a modem simulator environment.

methods.name: HandleUSSD
methods.description: Handles USSD commands from the client.

methods.name: HandleCLIR
methods.description: Handles CLIR (Calling Line Identification Restriction) commands.

methods.name: HandleCLIP
methods.description: Handles CLIP (Calling Line Identification Presentation) commands.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes command handlers for the service.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the internal state of the service.
